link_href.title: Link
link_href.description: Optional link of the announcement (its text is the notice_bar.text string, per language).

dismissible.title: Dismissible
dismissible.description: Visitors can close the bar; it stays closed for placement.frequency.dismissMemory.

sticky.title: Sticky
sticky.description: Keep the bar at the top while scrolling.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where and when the element renders: the shared placement v1 (paths, selectors, page types, devices, referrers, schedule, consent, triggers, frequency incl. cooldown and dismiss memory, audience rule). The Loader enforces it.
